name: Benita Mussorinni
source: Il Douché, the leader of the southern, sunny nation of Vitalia. This lazy and forgetful girl is determined to reignite a classical empire, stretching from Grecia to Gypta and beyond. A bit of a forgetful klutz and usually getting herself into trouble, she is an important ally and member of the Axle alliance. She likes pizza, pasta, naps, and burdening others with her self-inflicted problems.
